Mentioned in our stories

  • The Forty-Seat Marais Room That Manufactures French Comedy CareersA converted joinery in the Marais opened in 1975 under a different name, was taken over and renamed in 1978, and quietly became the room where French comedians are expected to prove a solo show works.
  • A Paris Comedy Room Built by Its Own Cast, in an Old Fan FactoryThe Café de la Gare opened in 1969 as a deliberately unhierarchical collective with equal profit shares and no admissions policy. Its founders included an unknown Coluche — and the category it invented, café-théâtre, started life as a tax classification.
